trends.name: Iran Crisis & Trump 8PM Deadline
trends.summary: President Trump issued an 8 PM ET deadline for Iran negotiations, threatening 'heavy strikes' and claiming 'whole civilization will die tonight' if deal not reached. IRGC declared 'new phase' of reprisal attacks; air defenses activated over Tehran. This geopolitical flashpoint is creating record market fear and uncertainty, with potential for nuclear escalation being discussed in real-time on X.

trends.name: Oil & Energy Prices Surge on Strait Crisis
trends.summary: Iran conflict threatens Strait of Hormuz shipping with potential $150/barrel oil scenarios. EIA expects WTI-Brent spread to gradually decline as flows resume, but geopolitical premium remains volatile. Energy and utilities sectors significantly outperforming tech and discretionary as investors rotate to safety.

trends.name: UN Security Council Gridlock on Middle East
trends.summary: China and Russia vetoed UN Security Council resolution on Strait of Hormuz shipping protection, preventing coordinated international response. U.S. Ambassador calling for 'responsible nations' to join unilaterally. This geopolitical fracture reduces multilateral solutions and increases unilateral military escalation risk.

trends.name: AWS Middle East Infrastructure Under Attack
trends.summary: AWS teams working around the clock after drone strikes to maintain Middle East service continuity. Cloud infrastructure vulnerability during geopolitical conflict creating operational and business continuity risks for enterprises dependent on regional services.

trends.name: Tech Sector Weakness Amid Geopolitical Risk
trends.summary: Technology and discretionary sectors significantly underperforming amid Iran crisis and broader uncertainty. Apple shares sinking on foldable iPhone delays; Arm stock falling after Morgan Stanley downgrade. Tech rotation out of favor as investors move to defensive energy/utilities positioning.

trends.name: AI Agentic Computing & Nvidia's Leadership
trends.summary: Nvidia positioned at singularity of agentic-as-a-service macroeconomy with emerging 'agents' driving next growth wave. OpenAI leadership changes (Sam Altman) and spat with Elon Musk signals competitive intensity in AI agent space. Critical for understanding AI monetization trajectory.

trends.name: Presidential Instability & 25th Amendment Speculation
trends.summary: Real-time X/Twitter posts show growing discussion of 25th Amendment removal proceedings amid Trump's Iran crisis threats and rhetoric about civilian casualties. Alex Jones calling for removal; journalists questioning nuclear strike procedures. Creates constitutional/political risk premium in markets.

trends.name: Silver & Precious Metals as Crisis Hedges
trends.summary: SILJ ETF offering value near potential silver bottom as investors seek real asset hedges amid geopolitical crisis and macro uncertainty. Precious metals rallying as safe-haven trade alongside energy commodities.

trends.name: Healthcare Sector Margin Expansion Thesis
trends.summary: UnitedHealth Group and broader healthcare sector benefiting from new CMS payment increases and margin expansion opportunities. UnitedHealth upgraded as margin expansion story despite broader market volatility. Defensive healthcare positioning attractive during geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: Corporate Tax Cuts Fueling Investment Cycle
trends.summary: Trump's 'Big Beautiful Bill' corporate tax cuts positioned as investment catalysts rather than giveaways, with potential to fund capex and growth. Autonomous vehicles, clean energy (Terrestrial Energy), and infrastructure sectors benefiting from reduced tax drag.

trends.name: Dollar Weakness & De-Dollarization Risks
trends.summary: Geopolitical fracturing accelerating de-dollarization trends as U.S. unilateral actions create incentives for alternative reserve currency arrangements. Currency composition shifts have major implications for asset allocation and emerging market opportunities.

trends.name: Transportation & Airline Cost Pressures
trends.summary: Airlines raising bag fees amid higher operating costs; gas prices above $4 creating margin pressure across transportation sector. Consumer discretionary spending facing headwinds from elevated energy and fuel costs linked to Middle East conflict.
